Do not treat mere containment or brief placement in the fridge as confirmed cooling, and do not immediately re-take an object already held—check inventory before re-taking. Cooling is an intermediate milestone; the task is complete only after the placement observation confirms the object is at the destination.
冷却后放置.when_to_apply: When the goal requires an object to be cooled and then placed at a specified destination.

冷却后放置.description: An object found in the fridge, or briefly placed into it, is not guaranteed to be in the required cooled state. Cooling should be performed or verified explicitly before the object is taken to the destination.
冷却后放置.why_it_happens: The agent may conflate storage location or containment with temperature state, or may assume that a fridge round-trip is sufficient cooling. The environment may only change temperature through an explicit cool interaction.
冷却后放置.how_to_avoid: Do not immediately retrieve and place an object after putting it into the fridge. While holding the target at an open fridge, use the environment's cool interaction and wait for a confirmation. If no cooled-state confirmation occurs, do not assume success.

冷却后放置.title: Bounded systematic search and early feasibility reassessment
冷却后放置.principle: Check a few high-probability locations first, including the fridge, countertops, dining table, cabinets, drawers, and shelves. Open containers as needed and track visited locations to avoid redundant loops. If the target is not in the fridge, continue a bounded systematic search across other plausible surfaces and containers rather than declaring failure after only opening the fridge. If the target is found on a surface such as a countertop or diningtable, take it directly and proceed to the fridge. If the target is not found after a reasonable broad search, reassess the goal or whether the object may be absent rather than continuing through every unrelated receptacle. Do not repeat an identical broad search after all obvious receptacles have been exhausted; report or escalate early when feasibility is doubtful.
冷却后放置.when_to_apply: When the target object is not immediately visible or is missing from its expected location, and many storage receptacles exist.

冷却后放置.description: Omitting the cooling phase and placing the object directly, or stopping after opening the fridge or cooling the object without final placement, leaves the goal incomplete. The task requires both a cooled object and placement at the required destination.
冷却后放置.why_it_happens: The goal may be misread as a simple placement task, or the cooling step may be treated as the whole mission. Premature handoff after a partial step also causes failure.
冷却后放置.how_to_avoid: Treat cooling and final placement as separate checkpoints. Include an explicit cooling step before placement when the goal requires a cool object, and after cooling continue to the destination and place the object. Do not declare success or hand off until both the cooled state and destination placement have been confirmed.

双物品放置.title: Sequential two-item placement with per-item confirmation and placed-count tracking
双物品放置.principle: Treat a two-item placement goal as two search-and-place cycles. Locate and take one target object, navigate to the destination, open the destination if it is closed, place the object, and confirm the placement before starting the second cycle. Track how many items are placed and which object was already placed; never take an already-placed object again, and do not emit HANDOFF after the first placement—each placement is a checkpoint, not task completion. If both instances are visible on the same surface or receptacle, place the first then return to that same location for the second. If the final destination is temporarily unavailable, only use a safe recoverable holding location when necessary and move both objects to the final destination afterward.
双物品放置.when_to_apply: When the goal requires placing two instances of the same object type at one target location and only one object can be carried at a time.

双物品放置.title: Systematic search across receptacle types and visible surfaces
双物品放置.principle: When target objects are not immediately visible, search broadly instead of checking only one receptacle type. Inspect visible surfaces such as counters, tables, shelves, sofas, and similar open surfaces first, then check closed containers such as cabinets and drawers, opening them before inspecting or taking from inside. Continue across multiple location types until the required number of instances is found or a checked-location record shows no remaining unchecked likely locations. When both target instances are visible on the same surface, take one, place it, then return to that same surface for the second rather than wandering to unrelated containers. Do not conclude the task is blocked prematurely.
双物品放置.when_to_apply: When one or both target objects are not visible and must be located in the environment.

双物品放置.description: Attempts to take a second object, or sometimes to move to another location, while already holding an object can return a no-op. This blocks progress in two-item placement if the held object is not released first.
双物品放置.why_it_happens: The environment commonly allows carrying only one object at a time, so take or movement actions may be rejected while inventory is occupied.
双物品放置.how_to_avoid: Before taking the second object or moving to search elsewhere, put the held object into the final destination or into a safe recoverable temporary location. Confirm the hands are empty, then continue.

双物品放置.description: A put action can produce no effect if it is issued before reaching the destination receptacle, or it can fail without the failure being noticed. Continuing to search for the second item after an unconfirmed first placement can leave the goal unsatisfied.
双物品放置.why_it_happens: Placement requires being at the target container and a successful put must be verified from the observation; otherwise the first item may still be held or not placed.
双物品放置.how_to_avoid: Navigate to the destination before placing. After each put, inspect the observation to confirm success. If the put did not succeed, move to the target if needed and retry before starting the next search or placement cycle.

双物品放置.description: Attempting to put an object into, or take an object from, a closed cabinet, drawer, or similar container may produce no effect. Additionally, issuing open on a container while standing at its parent furniture (e.g., open drawer 1 while at dresser 1) returns 'Nothing happens'; the actor must navigate to the container itself first.
双物品放置.why_it_happens: The environment requires the container to be open before its contents can be accessed or modified, and open actions are validated against the actor's current location being the container, not its parent furniture.
双物品放置.how_to_avoid: Navigate to the container itself, then open it with the appropriate open action. If it is already open, proceed; after opening, verify access before taking or placing. Do not issue open on a container from its parent furniture.

双物品放置.description: Using an examine-style action on objects or locations is not supported and returns no useful information.
双物品放置.why_it_happens: The available interaction set is limited to navigation, taking, putting, opening, and inventory-style operations; examining is not an effective substitute.
双物品放置.how_to_avoid: Inspect a location by navigating to the receptacle and observing its contents. Pick up visible target objects with a take action from that receptacle.

双物品放置.description: Placing an object into a non-target or unsuitable container such as a garbage can can make retrieval impossible or cause the overall two-item placement to fail.
双物品放置.why_it_happens: Some containers may not accept objects cleanly, may change object state, or may not allow reliable retrieval; temporary storage is only safe if the object can be taken back.
双物品放置.how_to_avoid: Prefer placing the first object directly into the final destination. If temporary holding is unavoidable, choose an open, stable, recoverable surface or container and avoid garbage cans or other likely irreversible containers.

双物品放置.description: After several containers have been opened and no target found, repeatedly revisiting locations already confirmed empty can exhaust the action budget and cause failure. Similarly, when go to a named location returns 'Nothing happens', repeating it wastes steps; switching to another candidate is required.
双物品放置.why_it_happens: Searching without tracking checked locations leads to redundant actions, while unchecked opened containers or visible surfaces may still contain the target. A no-change navigation indicates the target location is unreachable or invalid, so retrying it cannot help.
双物品放置.how_to_avoid: Maintain a mental or explicit list of checked locations. Prioritize unchecked opened containers and visible surfaces; take a target directly if it is visible. Avoid revisiting a location already confirmed to have no target unless new evidence suggests otherwise. After one no-change navigation, pick a different unchecked location.

双物品放置.description: Repeatedly declaring a subtask complete without executing the required next action can trigger a loop guard and terminate the episode before the two items are placed. Re-taking an already-placed item and re-placing it at a different instance of the destination also causes a handoff loop guard.
双物品放置.why_it_happens: The current state may be misread as satisfying the completion condition even though the actual goal or subgoal is unfinished, causing repeated signals instead of progress; or the destination instance may be confused, leading to re-taking a placed item.
双物品放置.how_to_avoid: Signal completion only after the corresponding subgoal is actually achieved, such as an object being taken or placed. After signaling, continue with the necessary next action and avoid repeating the same completion signal without new progress. Track which destination instance is the goal; once an item is placed at the target, do not re-take it—search for a second instance instead.
